snippet.title: It's John's House Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
It’s John’s House is coming soon on Steam! Add it to your wishlist or try the demo.
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3552200/Its_Johns_House/

Enter the house of Dr. John Revenwood, where nothing is what it seems. Every corner hides a secret, every mistake could be your last. Spot anomalies, survive his cruel games, and escape… if you can.
